The simile emphasizes speed and finality—lead drops straight down without floating. Cognates in other Semitic languages include ideas of sinking to rest or launching (Assyrian), and both sinking and floating (Ethiopic), showing semantic range around water motion."

The lead simile stresses weight and speed—no struggling or floating, just immediate submersion and death. This became one of Israel's central images of divine deliverance.
